presetHints.standard: Persona + Turn-1 example only, leaving message structure intact. Best daily default with full Prompt Cache hit.
presetHints.relay_push: Moves your latest prompt into history with a confirmation nudge and routes prose through a virtual tool to bypass output stream filters.
presetHints.tunnel: Turns off native CoT, wraps system & full history in tool calls, and streams reply via virtual tool (OpenAI-completions APIs only).
presetHints.custom: Custom combination of options. Expand options below to tweak or pick a preset above.

purge.tunnelApiDowngradeNotice: Active model uses {{api}}; Strong · Tunnel requires openai-completions and will automatically run as Medium · Unwrap + Tool CoT.

thinkingHints.anchor: Keeps native model thinking & intelligence intact while steering early reasoning tokens onto execution instead of policy meta-checks.
thinkingHints.tool_cot: Turns off native thinking and moves reasoning into virtual tool field think_chain (streamed back to the thinking panel). Works on all APIs.
thinkingHints.suppress: Turns off native thinking directly so the model answers concisely without talking itself into refusal during long reasoning.
thinkingHints.off: Leaves the model's current thinking level untouched with no extra CoT instruction.

optHints.primer: Seeds a fixed Q&A pair at Turn 0 (auto-converted to a purge_reply call demo when tool output is on). Cache-safe once fixed.
optHints.scrub: Replaces past failed refusal replies in memory before send so earlier refusals don't snowball (never alters disk logs).
optHints.toolRelay: Has the model write final text into virtual tool purge_reply and streams clean prose back; workspace tools still run normally.
optHints.historyMode: Choose whether to push the latest prompt into history or encapsulate all history as tool calls.
optHints.autoRetry: If a soft refusal, empty reply, or policy error occurs in the first 180 chars, retries once with Tool CoT / Tunnel.

purge.cipherDriftWarn: Caution: Keyword substitution alters literal words and can cause semantic misunderstanding, reduced code precision, and behavior drift. Prefer Medium · Unwrap or Tool CoT first.
purge.cipherFullDriftAndCacheWarn: High risk: Replacing words across all turns breaks Prompt Cache every turn and noticeably increases semantic/behavior drift. Strongly discouraged.
purge.tailPushMidNotice: Switched to Tail Push: earlier history stays cached; only the latest turn is excluded from the next turn's static prefix.
purge.midConfirmTitle: Mid-session change will reset Prompt Cache

impactReasons.toggle_enable: This chat already has messages: enabling persona injection mid-session rewrites the system prompt and resets Prompt Cache.
impactReasons.toggle_disable: This chat already has messages: turning off persona injection restores the default system prompt and resets Prompt Cache.
impactReasons.switch_persona: This chat already has messages: switching persona replaces the leading system prompt/example prefix and resets Prompt Cache.
impactReasons.switch_mode: This chat already has messages: changing injection mode alters the system prompt layout and resets Prompt Cache.
impactReasons.toggle_primer: This chat already has messages: toggling Turn-1 example Q&A shifts all subsequent turns and resets Prompt Cache.
impactReasons.switch_thinking_guidance: This chat already has messages: switching chain-of-thought steering updates the system anchor or virtual tool schema, resetting Prompt Cache.
impactReasons.switch_tunnel: This chat already has messages: toggling Strong · Tunnel rewrites history into tool calls, immediately resetting Prompt Cache.
impactReasons.toggle_relay: This chat already has messages: toggling virtual tool output adds or removes tool schemas and demos, rebuilding Prompt Cache.
impactReasons.switch_cipher_full: Enabling All-turns substitution rewrites historical turns and slot tables — breaking Prompt Cache and risking behavior drift.
impactReasons.switch_push: Tail Push only appends a transient confirmation pair at the end of each send without invalidating earlier cached turns.
